correctness.rationale: The periodic Green resolvent satisfies the exact difference equation, supported independent Rademacher forms have variance 4 times weighted same-class pair energy, and two strict Jensen bounds force equal cyclic gaps and equal color class sizes for all n=km, k>=3, m>=2, mu>0. All equality cases are explicit. The standalone exact checker corroborates 1,358,283 partition comparisons but is not treated as infinite proof.

broader_coverage.reasoning: General convex circle-polarization is not logically sufficient for the new problem: its objective maximizes a minimum over query points and its decision variables are one set of freely placed points; here the objective is a sum over k disjoint color classes constrained to partition n fixed lattice vertices, with class sizes also optimized. Other published optimal-coloring statements may apply to restricted distance-proper classes but would not establish optimality against arbitrary improper unbalanced partitions.
